about: Who answers each URL prefix: the controller (TandemApp), both the controller and an engine (each for its own state; `when` says when TandemApp answers it), an engine only, or nobody from outside. A reverse proxy in front of TandemApp sends it every controller prefix and every both prefix whose condition holds, and blocks the internal ones. docs/install.md#behind-a-reverse-proxy is this list in words; tests/test_route_list.py holds the two, the page's calls (dashboard/src) and the controller to it.

owners.controller: only TandemApp answers it; an engine answers 404
owners.both: TandemApp and an engine each answer it for their own state; `when`, if set, is the condition under which TandemApp answers it
owners.engine: only an engine answers it; TandemApp answers 404
owners.internal: for the controller's own host only; never route it from outside

match.prefix: the path itself and every path under it (prefix + '/')
